fee_notes: Two royalty structures apply: (1) Conversion franchisees pay 9% of Gross Receipts, with a discounted rate of 5% in months 1-12 and 6.5% in months 13-24 if paid timely; minimum royalty applies after 24 months. (2) Start-Up franchisees pay the greater of 9% of Gross Receipts OR a tiered monthly minimum starting at $100/mo and stepping up to $1,500/mo for the remainder of the term. Franchisor reserves the right to increase the royalty rate up to two times per term, not to exceed 12%. A royalty rebate program exists for franchisees in good standing, ranging from 0% to a maximum of 4.5% of Gross Receipts based on revenue tiers. Advertising Fund contribution is up to 2% of Gross Receipts but has not yet been established; not required until at least 50% of franchisees participate. A PAS License Fee (software) of $7,020-$7,370/year is charged annually — not a monthly tech fee. The $1,500/mo figure used for royalty_min_monthly reflects the highest disclosed minimum tier for Start-Up franchisees.

Royalty Fee on Padgett Services – Conversion (Note 1, 6): 9% (Note 7) of Gross Receipts except that during the first twelve-month period, the Royalty Rate is 5% for each month Royalties are paid in a timely manner and during the second twelve-month period, the Royalty Rate is 6.5% for each month Royalties are paid in a timely manner. Minimum shall apply after 24 months. Payable monthly no later than the 10th day of each month (Note 3). The royalty fees for some services are subject to a rebate. (Note 4)

Royalty Fee on Padgett Services – Start-Up Franchisee (Note 1, 6): The greater of 9% (Note 7) of Gross Receipts (Note 2) OR: $100/mo. for the first three months of operation after the First Six-Month Period; $200/mo. for the second three months of operation after the First Six-Month Period; $400/mo. for the third three months of operation after the First Six-Month Period; $600/mo. for the fourth three months of operation after the First Six-Month Period; $800/mo. for the fifth three months of operation after the First Six-Month Period; $1,000/mo. for the next consecutive 9 months of operation after the First Six-Month Period; $1,200/mo. for the next consecutive 12 months of operation after the First Six-Month Period; $1,500/mo. for the remainder of the Franchise Agreement term. Payable monthly no later than the 10th day of each month (Note 3). The royalty fees for some services are subject to a rebate. (Note 4)

Advertising Fund Contribution (Note 6): Up to 2% of Gross Receipts. Payable Monthly no later than the 10th day of each month. (Note 3). The Franchise Agreement gives us the right to establish an advertising Fund and to require you to make this contribution. We have not yet established the Fund.

PAS License Fee: $7,020 - $7,370 per year (depending on the payment terms chosen). Prior to opening and annually thereafter.
